title: Performance Engineering
prereqs: Python (challenges use a local load/profile harness)
description: Make it fast and prove it: performance methodology (measure, don't guess; USE/RED), load testing (open vs closed models, think time), latency & percentiles (why p99, coordinated omission), profiling (CPU/memory hotspots, flamegraphs), concurrency & throughput (Little's Law, queueing), caching & data-path tuning, and capacity planning — each a runnable, measured, pytest-judged exercise.
